description: Calculate funding rate arbitrage profit: annualized yield, net profit, and breakeven days for a long/short basis trade across two exchanges: the bare numbers only, no plain-English verdict. For the same math plus a profitable/marginal/loss verdict, use workflow.run_carry_trade instead. Edge cases: positionSize and durationDays above zero; longFundingRate and shortFundingRate in percent per interval (0.01 is 0.01%), either sign; transferFeePct 0 or more (default 0.1); intervalHours 0.25 to 24 (default 8). Not covered: price divergence between the venues, liquidation of either leg, margin on both venues, a rate that changes during the hold, and trading fees. Use when user asks "is this funding arb worth it?" or "how many days to break even on transfer fees?". Returns: netProfitUsdt, annualizedYieldPct, breakevenDays.

intervalHours.description: Hours between funding payments, one interval for both legs. Default 8; 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack (per-hour rates); 4 or 2 on some symbols. A leg paid on another interval is entered as its rate times (this interval / its own interval).

longFundingRate.description: Funding rate on long side (% per interval, positive = you pay)

shortFundingRate.description: Funding rate on short side (% per interval, positive = you receive)

transferFeePct.description: One-time transfer/setup fee as percentage, e.g. 0.1 for 0.1%

name: workflow.run_funding_arbitrage
title: Funding Arbitrage
